positions.title: Barista (Certified - Coffee Master)
positions.description:
• Certified July 2022 Coffee Master, expert knowledge in regional coffees, brewing, and harvest.
• Work in a fast-paced environment where accuracy and precision are as critical as customer support and connection.
• Able to multitask and manage multiple roles in a high stress environment.
• Experience in teamwork, collaboration, and customer satisfaction.

positions.title: Application Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Leveraged Oracle's CPQ Platform and implemented System Configuration technology to further streamline the opportunity-to-quote-to-order process on Workforce Now and RUN.
• Developed multiple 'Bill of Material' Mapping Rules to allow administrators to associate fulfillment system BOMs to an Oracle CPQ Configuration.
• Utilized BML language to convert existing sales code base to a more future-proof format (BOM).
